opus.problem: Six of the seven clues come from Genesis and cover only the patriarch. The word is best known for the tribe and the southern kingdom of Judah: its kings, its capital Jerusalem, and its exile to Babylon. None of the clues use these, so the best-known stories are left out.

This clue uses a minor opening line of Judah's plea. The best-known part of the story is Judah offering to stay as Joseph's slave in place of Benjamin. The pronoun is also unclear: 'saying he was equal to Pharaoh himself' can be read as Judah saying this about himself.
